test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In the expression "A > B le C", which of the following statements is definitely true?
solution:
Given: A > B ≤ C

(1) A False (As per the statement A > B)

(2) B ≤ C → True

(3) A > C → Not definitely true (A > B ≤ C)

(4) B > C → False (As per the statement B ≤ C)

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
